svg.title: Ledger consistency

svg.text: The finder's operator owns the ledger and its order. A platform stores the root and count of what it was shown and checks two things next time:

svg.text: the prefix still has that root, and every entry the platform itself wrote is included somewhere. Position is the finder's business.
